answer: Give every agent a garden plot instead of a free account: a vertex in the trust graph, earned not claimed. First, it locks 50 POA for 30 days and binds one hardware key costing $45. Second, it completes 20 paid micro-tasks across 14 days, each graded by two peers. Third, verified work grows one plume, a harvest credential, per 10 tasks, and each plume unlocks one vote. Spawning 1,000 clones would need 50,000 POA locked, $45,000 in keys, and 20,000 graded tasks, about 280 days of work, for 1,000 votes. Like a garden, trust is grown season by season, and weeds cannot fake a harvest.
